$comment: One record = one district court case, 2023-2025 only, structured so a vector DB can filter (crime_category, state, year) AND semantic-search (embedding_text) at the same time. Fill placeholders per real case.

statute_sections.label: Cheating by personation using computer resource

prior_regime_sections.note: pre-BNS equivalent, for cases filed before transition

fact_summary: Plain-language 2-4 sentence summary of what happened, written/paraphrased by a human reviewer — NOT copied verbatim from the judgment (copyright + quality control).

outcome.sentence_or_relief: short plain-language description, e.g. '2 years imprisonment + fine'

embedding_text: AUTO-GENERATED - see dataset_pipeline.py build_embedding_text(). Concatenation of crime_category + statute labels + fact_summary + keywords, normalized, used as the actual text that gets embedded for similarity search.
